description: One speaker or a presentation. Starts each sentence's Japanese about 1-3 s earlier than 'careful' (measured on recorded talks, configuration P3d). Cuts chunks after 5 words or 2.5 s, so more and shorter chunks. Uses the LLM engine (Bedrock): the bundle was tuned and measured with it, and on a judged sample it scored 4.1 of 5 against 3.0 for Amazon Translate for about $1.17 vs $1.06 per 4-hour session plus 0.6 s per chunk.
